title: Mallorca vs Ibiza: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Mallorca for variety, value, and almost everyone. Ibiza for world-class electronic music clubs and Cala Comte sunsets.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Mallorca runs €80–120/day vs Ibiza's €100–160+. Club entry alone at Ibiza costs €50–100+

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Mallorca has 260+ beaches; Ibiza has fewer but Cala Comte and Formentera access are world-class

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Ibiza is the undisputed global capital of electronic music — Ushuaïa, Pacha, DC10, Amnesia

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Palma's restaurant scene punches above its weight; Ibiza is good but expensive

categories.name: Cultural Depth
categories.summary: Palma cathedral, Moorish history, mountain villages vs Ibiza Town's Dalt Vila

categories.name: Nature & Hiking
categories.summary: Serra de Tramuntana (UNESCO) and 262 beaches vs Ibiza's flatter rural north

categories.name: Family-Friendliness
categories.summary: Mallorca has calm bays, resort towns, and variety; Ibiza's party identity bleeds everywhere in peak season

categories.name: Instagram / Sunsets
categories.summary: Es Vedrà and Cala Comte at sunset are among the Mediterranean's most photographed views

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Mallorca has endless internal variety; Ibiza's ace card is 30-min ferry to Formentera

faq.question: Is Mallorca or Ibiza better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Mallorca for most travelers. Ibiza only if clubs or Formentera are the priority.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Mallorca or Ibiza?
faq.answer: Mallorca is 25–40% cheaper across all spending categories. Ibiza club entry adds €50–100+ per night.

faq.question: Which has better beaches?
faq.answer: Tie. Mallorca has 260+ beaches and variety. Ibiza has fewer but Cala Comte and Formentera are world-class.
